turns.text: And don't forget to subscribe to Max and Mia for more practical English learning content.
turns.zh: 还有别忘了订阅 Max 和 Mia，获取更多实用英语学习内容。

turns.text: We release new episodes every week with real conversations and useful tips for intermediate learners.
turns.zh: 我们每周都会更新新一期节目，里面有真实对话和适合中级学习者的实用小技巧。

turns.text: Until next time, keep practicing, keep conversations going, and remember, you're doing great.
turns.zh: 我们下次见，继续练习，让对话继续下去，记住，你做得很好。
